title: It is never explained anywhere why some undead (barrow-wight, gray sergeant, Lost Sentry, honour guard) ignore armor entirely while others (lean wolf, gray husk, bog-thing, slag-hound) do not; the pattern (Founding-era undead vs. everything else) is guessable in hindsight but not stated.
